title: 实现 Standalone 最小纵向链路的可独立部分
objective: 在工程骨架上实现 Standalone 最小纵向链路中不依赖公共契约变更的部分：conversation、render-job、provider-adapter（确定性 Fake Provider）、candidate 隔离存储、skin-validator 接线、finalization（Standalone 存储成品）、retention-cleanup 与最小 Web 流程（创建→渲染→轮询→确认）；候选预览、最终下载、会话详情与匿名安全模式作为契约缺口记录，留待 Contracts 工作流。
in_scope: API：POST /v1/conversations、POST /v1/conversations/{id}/renders、POST /v1/conversations/{id}/finalize、GET /v1/jobs/{id}（全部为已发布 0.1.0-draft 已定义操作），含 Idempotency-Key 指纹与 409 语义
conversation 模块：会话创建、初始消息、30 天过期、最多三次实际渲染的状态机接线
render-job 模块：BullMQ 异步任务、重试、取消、死信与标准错误分类落地
provider-adapter 接线：FakeProvider（开发/测试环境，返回已验证 fixture；生产模式禁止实例化）
candidate 模块：隔离存储（candidates/ 前缀、不可预测键）、24 小时过期元数据、SHA-256 与字节数
finalization：确认候选、最终 64×64/双层校验、Standalone 模式成品存储与幂等
retention-cleanup：周期清理任务（对话 30 天、候选与失败文件 24 小时）、清理失败重试、可控时钟测试
Web 最小流程：创建会话、请求渲染、渲染状态与次数显示、按候选 ID 确认成品；预览与下载在契约缺口补全前明确禁用并说明
契约缺口记录：候选预览字节、Standalone 最终下载、会话详情/消息、匿名安全模式
out_of_scope: 公共 OpenAPI、JSON Schema 或 SDK 修改（契约缺口只记录，另开 Contracts 主仓库工作流）
候选预览与最终下载的公开端点实现（等待契约补全）
Official 登录、Keycloak、Core 额度或积分、Community 发布、OAuth 社区授权
正式 AI 厂商调用、正式内容审核供应商、3D 预览库选择
生产域名、生产密钥、真实云资源、远程推送
contract_impact: none within this workflow; gaps are recorded for a sequential Contracts-primary workstream: candidate preview bytes, standalone final download, conversation detail/messages, and anonymous security mode semantics cannot be expressed by skin.yaml 0.1.0-draft
acceptance_evidence: All four published contract operations are implemented and verified against skin.yaml 0.1.0-draft shapes (201/202/409/404 and problem+json errors)
Idempotency-Key fingerprints reject reuse with a different body and replay returns the original result without duplicating state

The render job runs end to end in integration tests: FakeProvider returns a validated fixture, the candidate is stored under the isolated candidates/ prefix with SHA-256 and 24-hour expiry, and the job reports candidate_id
Finalization re-validates 64x64/double-layer bytes, is idempotent, and in standalone mode stores the final skin without contacting any external service
Retention cleanup deletes expired conversations and candidates with an injectable clock, and cleanup failures enter a retry path
Concurrent render requests cannot exceed the three-attempt limit
The web minimal flow creates a conversation, requests renders, polls job status, displays attempt counts, and finalizes by candidate id with preview/download visibly disabled pending the contract gap
Contract gaps are recorded precisely in this workstream record and in the repository docs

Playwright end-to-end smoke passed (17.4s): real PostgreSQL + Redis containers, API dist and worker dist running, browser flow created a conversation, requested a render, watched the render job report succeeded with a candidate, confirmed the product, and the finalize job reached succeeded
